source: Sudarshana's synthesis from the classics: each nakshatra's deity, shakti and nature read on each bhava's matters (BPHS 11, Phaladeepika 1.10-16)
about: The nakshatra a bhava's cusp falls in gives the bhava's matters the star's own colour: its deity's gift, its shakti and its temperament. Its lord, the cusp's star lord, carries the bhava's results to the bhava it sits in.
